records.rationale: Each stack-trace frame (a single Deno-captured 'at Func (file:line:col)' line, D-03) is rendered as its own full-width, left-aligned, monospace, keyboard-focusable button so a click/Enter/Space can jump the editor to that line. No existing design-system primitive fits: Button enforces fixed 32/28/44px height plus icon+label layout, unsuitable for a variable-length wrapped technical readout line; ListRow's icon/label/meta/selected layout is built for a navigable list row, not a preformatted stack-frame line. The Show/Hide stack trace disclosure toggle in this same file was converted to the real Button primitive (13-27-PLAN.md Task 2) precisely so this exception stays narrowly scoped to the one raw-button pattern with no primitive fit, rather than exempting the whole file.
records.reviewCondition: a shared 'preformatted clickable technical row' primitive is added to the design system
